title: World spec
description: Structured world specification inside the case manifest.json: story beats under contract.story, entity contracts under object_contracts, scene graph under topology [paper A.1.1]. Field names follow the experiment case outputs; where they disagree, the majority name is used. Other manifest keys are allowed.

object_contracts.description: Entity contracts, one per object whose motion, deformation, emission, or contact is part of the claim [paper A.1.1 'Entity contracts'; non-penetration-contract.en.md].

long_form.description: Long-form classification [simulation-workflow.en.md 1.2]. Wording about delivery or rendering (e.g. 'Final ... render') never makes a request long-form. When true and requested_duration_seconds is absent, contract.frame_range must last at least 12 s [bin/spec_audit.py duration].

minimum_duration_seconds.description: Total minimum duration; contract.frame_range must last at least this long at contract.fps [bin/spec_audit.py duration].

requested_duration_seconds.description: Duration stated in the request, if any. It takes precedence: the long-form minimum duration applies only when the request states none [simulation-workflow.en.md 1.2].

beat.description: One story beat [paper A.1.1; skill.md:74 story_contract].

owner.description: Responsible solver or input, free text, e.g. 'Mantaflow gravity over 3 physical steps' [paper A.1.1].

depends_on.description: Beat ids that must occur first [skill.md:74 'order/dependency'].

allowed_inputs.description: Keyed forces, emitters, switches, or kinematic boundaries that may drive this beat [simulation-workflow.en.md 1.2].

interactions.description: Claims in this beat that one solver_graph node moves, deforms, displaces or triggers an object of another node [paper 3.2.2 'Causal'; A.1.2]. bin/spec_audit.py coupling_claim matches each against the graph's edges.

achievable.description: false: agreed with the user that no channel provides this; the covering row is reported blocked.

reason.description: Why it is not achievable; required with achievable false.

solver_owner.description: The one solver that owns the claimed output, free text, e.g. 'fixed authored environment' [non-penetration-contract.en.md Solver ownership].

simulation_class.description: Physical target of this object [SKILL.md 'Solver Classification']: the case classes of contract.simulation_class except coupled, plus fixed and kinematic for objects no solver moves. An object that only has a Fluid Flow, Fluid Effector, Collision or force-field role (emitter, obstacle, collider) is fixed or kinematic, not the class of the domain or body it acts on. Names and preferred systems: schemas/solver_classes.json.

blender_system.description: The Blender system that simulates this object; none for a plain collider or keyed object. Only the simulated object carries the system (the gas or liquid domain, the cloth, the soft body, the active rigid body, the owner of a simulated particle system); an emitter, obstacle or collider with only a Fluid Flow, Fluid Effector, Collision or force-field role is none (systems.physics_roles lists roles). A passive or animated rigid body in the rigid body world is bullet_rigid_body.

evidence.description: Case-relative paths of measured reports (probe or verifier reports, trace) that show why the preferred system was not used.

solver_choice_reason.description: Required when blender_system is not a preferred system for simulation_class in schemas/solver_classes.json [bin/spec_audit.py solver_choice].

initial_support.description: Supporting object name, 'foundation' or 'ground' [non-penetration-contract.en.md support chain]; several joined with '|'. Omit it for an object released in free fall (dropped, thrown, or airborne at the first frame).

acceptance.description: Acceptance conditions, e.g. 'zero interpenetration across full range'.

topology.description: Scene graph: regions, connections, support, solver coupling [paper A.1.1 'Scene graph'; skill.md:75]. Cases may use other shapes.

edges.description: Each edge is [from, connection, to] [paper A.2.1 navigability].

coupling.description: Prose notes only; the checked coupling graph is solver_graph.

solver_graph.description: Coupling graph [paper A.1.2 'coupling direction, exchanged variables, state ownership, driving boundaries, and bake order'; material-playbooks.en.md section 7]: one node per solver bake (or per input), one edge per one-way state transfer, and the bake order. A solver node's solver is the common blender_system of its objects. Channels and what each provides: schemas/coupling_channels.json. Required when objects are simulated by two or more Blender systems or contract.simulation_class lists coupled [bin/spec_audit.py solver_graph_required].

bake_order.description: Node ids, each once, in the order their caches are baked; input nodes included.

objects.description: Solver node: the object_contracts it simulates, all with one blender_system. Input node: the driving objects, kinematic object contracts or names listed in an allowed_inputs.

input.description: Set for a node that is not a solver bake: keyed (keyed or driven motion, kinematic bodies, keyed constraint values) or force_field (force field objects).

domain.description: Fluid nodes (flip_fluids, mantaflow_*): Blender name of the domain object when it is not one of objects.

cache.description: Case-relative cache directory, or 'in .blend' for a point cache kept in the file.

channel.description: How the state passes; schemas/coupling_channels.json lists which systems each channel joins.

objects.description: Driver-node objects (or its domain) that act through the channel.

targets.description: Driven-node objects the edge acts on; omitted: all of them.

via.description: Blender objects that carry the channel but are not driver objects: the Fluid Flow field, the hook target, the motor constraint object a script writes.

exchanged.description: State the driven solver reads, e.g. 'pose per frame', 'grid velocity'.

omitted_reactions.description: What the driven side would push back and does not, e.g. 'water pressure and buoyancy on the crate'. May be empty only for an input-node driver or event_timing.

approximation.description: Required for channels marked approximation in schemas/coupling_channels.json: what is approximated and how.

method.description: scripted_transfer only: case-relative script path, then ': ' and what it computes.

assumptions.description: scripted_transfer only: assumed values, e.g. 'density 1000 kg/m3', 'Cd = 1'.

settings.description: Blender values the coupling depends on, keyed '<object>.<RNA path>' (or an RNA path that applies to every via object), e.g. {'field.flow': 1.0} for a field_flow carrier; worldagent_measure.coupling.graph_links compares them with the scene.
